title: Test: Python DTN store respects capacity and TTL
description: Write tests: (1) store up to max_entries, verify reject on overflow. (2) store with ttl=1s, advance time, expire() removes it. (3) retrieve returns stored payload. (4) relay-class store holds 256, leaf-class holds 0. Verify: cd python && python -m pytest tests/test_dtn_store.py -x
